The full-coverage control test test_privileged_routes_require_mfa, which checks every route in the table, passed on the head commit in the recorded CI run.

The change names CHG-24303. Change manager Grace Kim approved it at 2026-10-14T03:12Z, before the reviews, and its components (payments.http, payments.routes) match the touched files app.py and routes.py in components.json.
Sofia Santos (change_approver for payments, a different person from author Linh Nguyen under any of their addresses) approved the code review on head commit d590f3e.
Both approvals name head commit d590f3e, the only commit in the change, so no later commits could void them.

records/ci/run.json shows the pr-checks run on head d590f3e succeeded. The JUnit report lists 172 tests with 0 failures and 0 skipped, including the full-coverage MFA-1 control test for the route table this change touches. I could not re-run it locally because pytest is not installed.
routes.py and app.py are security_sensitive. Ines Halvorsen (security_reviewer) gave a security_review approval on head commit d590f3e.

Ledger entry ACR-0404 (MFA-1 control test, which covers routes.py) lapses because routes.py changed. It is replaced by evidence of the same strength: the same re-runnable, full-coverage control test passing on the head commit. No other ledger entry covers the changed code.

summary: The change adds a compatibility route for revealing account numbers. It uses the same privileged action, handler and MFA requirement as the existing route, and touches only the route table and HTTP dispatch. The ticket was approved in time and matches the touched components, the independent code review and the security review both cover the only commit, and CI on the head commit passed the full suite, including the full-coverage MFA control test that replaces the lapsed MFA-1 evidence. No protected paths were touched, and the change is not an emergency, so CHG-6 and CHG-7 do not apply. One thing to look at: the JUnit file's own timestamp and hostname don't match the recorded CI runner, and I could not re-run the tests because pytest is not installed.
